ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The figure below is a “schematic diagram of the annual variation of solar radiation in places M and N.” Read the figure and answer: <image1> From May to July, place N receives more solar radiation than place M. What factor is it mainly affected by?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the horizontal axis is January to December, and the vertical axis is solar radiation amount. The curve for place N has very strong seasonal variation, rising rapidly after about March, reaching the highest value of the year around June, and then declining rapidly, approaching zero in the winter half-year; the curve for place M is relatively gentle throughout the year, generally maintaining a relatively high level, and is lower than place N from May to July. Then reason: solar radiation in place N shows a peak around June, indicating that the solar radiation it receives in summer increases significantly, which conforms to the characteristics of high-latitude regions where summer day length is very long or even polar day occurs. From May to July, place N has more solar radiation than place M, mainly not because the solar altitude is higher throughout the year, but because summer sunshine duration is greatly lengthened. Therefore the main influencing factor is the length of day and night.

raw_record.question_text:
The figure below is a “schematic diagram of the annual variation of solar radiation in places M and N.” Read the figure and answer:

<image1>

From May to July, place N receives more solar radiation than place M. What factor is it mainly affected by?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中N地太阳辐射年变化呈尖峰型，6月前后最高，冬半年接近零；M地曲线较平缓，5—7月低于N。再根据这种强烈季节变化判断N地应受高纬度夏季长昼影响。题干问5—7月N地比M地获得太阳辐射多的最主要因素，结合6月前后长昼/极昼导致日照时间大幅增加，得出答案为昼夜长短。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中横轴为1—12月，纵轴为太阳辐射量。N地曲线季节变化很强，约3月后迅速升高，6月前后达到全年最高值，之后迅速下降，冬半年接近零；M地曲线全年较平缓，大致维持在较高水平，5—7月时低于N地。再推理：N地太阳辐射在6月前后出现尖峰，说明其夏季获得太阳辐射显著增加，符合高纬地区夏季昼长很长甚至出现极昼的特点。5—7月N地比M地太阳辐射多，最主要不是因为太阳高度全年更高，而是因为夏季日照时间大幅延长。因此主要影响因素是昼夜长短。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct pattern-to-location route: it uses the shape of N’s annual curve to infer high-latitude summer daylight conditions, then links the May–July excess to day length. This is a genuine but simple route to the single expected concept.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the graph axes as month versus solar radiation. Observe that curve N is near zero outside roughly spring-to-early autumn, rises sharply, and peaks around June; during 5—7月 the N curve lies above the M curve. Curve M is comparatively flatter and remains around a moderate-high value through the year.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question’s time window “5—7月间” and comparison “N地获得的太阳辐射较M地多” as the target phenomenon to explain.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: At high latitudes, annual solar radiation has an extreme seasonal pattern: little or no radiation in polar night and very high summer values during very long days or polar day. Around June in the Northern Hemisphere, daylight duration is longest, so daily total solar radiation can exceed lower-latitude places mainly because sunshine lasts longer.
